title: Lake Purdy Fishing
specs: Lake Purdy is a state water reservoir with clean water
Fishing for lunker bass, crappie, bream and catfish
Please bring a valid driver's license or form of identification with you to check in.
No outside boats allowed on the lake
Bass and motor boats capacity 3 people

services.desc: Fully Rigged Boat with bow-mounted trolling motor, live-well, Helix 7 depth finder, 25 HP motor Capacity: 3

explain.meaning: A flat, steady boat on two floats, good for relaxed groups.

includes: Gas included with all motorized boats
blurb: Guests rent various boats including pontoon, bass boats, aluminum fishing boats with motors, and non-motorized boats. Rentals include life jackets and paddles; motorized boats include gas. The site also sells fishing tackle, live bait, and outboard motors.
extraNote: In cases of severe or inclement weather, raincheck or reschedule issued; no refunds · Night rentals are in-person only, must be at bait shop before closing to rent · Bait shop at Lake Purdy
